name: Manual entries through internal or suspense accounts hiding customer flows
description: Funds move via manual journals, suspense, clearing or staff-controlled internal accounts, so customer-level records do not show the real origin, destination or beneficial party.
fp: Operational corrections, reconciliations and settlement timing legitimately use internal accounts. Review ageing, authorisers and counterparties.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance on Correspondent Banking Services, 2016
Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, Sound management of risks related to money laundering and financing of terrorism, 2014 (revised 2020)

links.name: Manual entries through internal or suspense accounts hiding customer flows
links.ctx: Lets an insider move or conceal funds outside normal monitoring, and is usually found by audit or ledger analytics.
